title: The Bhagavad Gita
description: Based on HH Sri Raghavendra Teertha's Gita Vivruti

verses.sanskrit:
धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः |
मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय ||
verses.transliteration:
dharmakṣetre kurukṣetre samavetā yuyutsavaḥ |
māmakāḥ pāṇḍavāścaiva kimakurvata sañjaya ||
verses.translation: Dhrutarashtra said: O Sanjaya! Assembled at Kuru Kshetra, the designated land for committing righteous acts (Field of Righteousness), what did my clan of Kauravas and Pandavas do?

verses.sanskrit:
दृष्ट्वा तु पाण्डवानीकं व्यूढं दुर्योधनस्तदा |
आचार्यमुपसंगम्य राजा वचनमब्रवीत् ||
verses.transliteration:
dṛṣṭvā tu pāṇḍavānīkaṁ vyūḍhaṁ duryodhanastadā |
ācāryamupasaṅgamya rājā vacanamabravīt ||
verses.translation: Sanjaya said: King Duryodhana, upon seeing the formation of the Pandavas' army, immediately rushed to his teacher Drona, and said as follows.

verses.sanskrit:
पश्यैतां पाण्डुपुत्राणामाचार्य महतीं चमूम् |
व्यूढां द्रुपदपुत्रेण तव शिष्येण धीमता ||
verses.transliteration:
paśyaitāṁ pāṇḍuputrāṇāmācārya mahatīṁ camūm |
vyūḍhāṁ drupadaputreṇa tava śiṣyeṇa dhīmatā ||
verses.translation: O My Teacher! Look at the formation of the mighty army of Pandavas which has been organized by your clever student Dhrushtadyumna, son of Drupada.

verses.sanskrit:
अत्र शूरा महेष्वासा भीमार्जुनसमा युधि |
युयुधानो विराटश्च द्रुपदश्च महारथः ||
verses.transliteration:
atra śūrā maheṣvāsā bhīmārjunasamā yudhi |
yuyudhāno virāṭaśca drupadaśca mahārathaḥ ||
verses.translation: Possessing heavy weapons are the brave warriors Yuyudhana (Satyaki), Virata, and King Drupada, all Maharathas. They are as capable as Bheema and Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit:
धृष्टकेतुश्चेकितानः काशिराजश्च वीर्यवान् |
पुरुजित्कुन्तिभोजश्च शैब्यश्च नरपुंगवः ||
verses.transliteration:
dhṛṣṭaketuścekitānaḥ kāśirājaśca vīryavān |
purujitkuntibhojaśca śaibyaśca narapuṅgavaḥ ||
verses.translation: Other brave warriors include Drushtaketu, Chekitana, Kashiraja who are extraordinarily strong, Purujit, Kuntibhoja and Shybhya who are superior among men.

verses.sanskrit:
युधामन्युश्च विक्रान्त उत्तमौजाश्च वीर्यवान् |
सौभद्रो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्व एव महारथाः ||
verses.transliteration:
yudhāmanyuśca vikrānta uttamaujāśca vīryavān |
saubhadro draupadeyāśca sarva eva mahārathāḥ ||
verses.translation: Yudhamanyu, the brave warrior, Uttamowja, the strong warrior, Abhimanyu, son of Subhadra, and sons of Draupadi are also here. They too are Maharathas.

verses.sanskrit:
अस्माकं तु विशिष्टा ये तान्निबोध द्विजोत्तम |
नायका मम सैन्यस्य संज्ञार्थं तान्ब्रवीमि ते ||
verses.transliteration:
asmākaṁ tu viśiṣṭā ye tānnibodha dvijottama |
nāyakā mama sainyasya saṁjñārthaṁ tānbravīmi te ||
verses.translation: O Drona! Superior among the wise men! Now I will enumerate the great warriors from our side. So, please listen with attention.

verses.sanskrit:
भवान्भीष्मश्च कर्णश्च कृपश्च समितिंजयः |
अश्वत्थामा विकर्णश्च सौमदत्तिस्तथैव च ||
verses.transliteration:
bhavānbhīṣmaśca karṇaśca kṛpaśca samitiṁjayaḥ |
aśvatthāmā vikarṇaśca saumadattistathāiva ca ||
verses.translation: Our side includes yourself, Bheeshma, Karna, Krupa who has won many wars, Ashwatthama, Vikarna and Bhoorishravas, son of Somadatta.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्ये च बहवः शूरा मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः |
नानाशस्त्रप्रहरणाः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः ||
verses.transliteration:
anye ca bahavaḥ śūrā madarthe tyaktajīvitāḥ |
nānāśastrapraharaṇāḥ sarve yuddhaviśāradāḥ ||
verses.translation: Along with them are many warriors ready to sacrifice their lives for my sake. They are all well versed in wars and are armed with heavy weapons.

verses.sanskrit:
अपर्याप्तं तदस्माकं बलं भीष्माभिरक्षितम् |
पर्याप्तं त्विदमेतेषां बलं भीमाभिरक्षितम् ||
verses.transliteration:
aparyāptaṁ tadasmākaṁ balaṁ bhīṣmābhirakṣitam |
paryāptaṁ tvidameteṣāṁ balaṁ bhīmābhirakṣitam ||
verses.translation: But our army headed by Bheeshma is not strong enough to defeat them. While their army headed by Bheema can defeat us.

verses.sanskrit:
अयनेषु च सर्वेषु यथाभागमवस्थिताः |
भीष्ममेवाभिरक्षन्तु भवन्तः सर्व एव हि ||
verses.transliteration:
ayaneṣu ca sarveṣu yathābhāgamavasthitāḥ |
bhīṣmamevābhirakṣantu bhavantaḥ sarva eva hi ||
verses.translation: Hence all of you need to position yourselves in your designated spots in the formations and guard Bheeshma, our commander.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य संजनयन्हर्षं कुरुवृद्धः पितामहः |
सिंहनादं विनद्योच्चैः शङ्खं दध्मौ प्रतापवान् ||
verses.transliteration:
tasya saṁjanayannharṣaṁ kuruvṛddhaḥ pitāmahaḥ |
siṁhanādaṁ vinadyoccaiḥ śaṅkhaṁ dadhmau pratāpavān ||
verses.translation: To cheer up Duryodhana, the valiant grandfather Bheeshma, the eldest of the Kurus, blew his conch shell loudly, producing a sound like the roar of a lion.

कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन |
मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि ||

karmaṇyevādhikāraste mā phaleṣu kadācana |

verses.sanskrit:
ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः संगस्तेषूपजायते |
संगात्संजायते कामः कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते ||
verses.transliteration:
dhyāyato viṣayānpuṁsaḥ saṅgasteṣūpajāyate |
saṅgātsañjāyate kāmaḥ kāmātkrodho'bhijāyate ||
verses.translation: While contemplating the objects of the senses, a person develops attachment for them, and from such attachment lust develops, and from lust anger arises.

verses.sanskrit:
क्रोधाद्भवति संमोहः संमोहात्स्मृतिविभ्रमः |
स्मृतिभ्रंशाद्बुद्धिनाशो बुद्धिनाशात्प्रणश्यति ||
verses.transliteration:
krodhādbhavati sammohaḥ sammohātsmṛtivibhramaḥ |
smṛtibhraṁśādbuddhināśo buddhināśātpraṇaśyati ||
verses.translation: From anger, complete delusion arises, and from delusion bewilderment of memory. When memory is bewildered, intelligence is lost, and when intelligence is lost one falls down again into the material pool.
